name: Zynaps GS: topcells
summary: The developer switch and the work cells over the ROM font's leftover.

labels.name: FontLeftover
labels.comment: the lines 4-6 of the ROM's 'P' ($7C, $40, $40), no code reads them

labels.name: Invulnerable
labels.comment: the developer switch: not 0 = the ship cannot be killed

labels.name: WorkGlyph
labels.comment: an 8-byte work cell: $8EC5 copies a glyph of $72A9 + 8 n here, $8EA1 draws it (on the tape: the ROM's 'Q')

labels.name: ColumnFlags
labels.comment: 32 flags a screen column (to $FFFF, past the image): cleared by $8C3B at each level start ($8CD9, LDIR of 32 bytes $FFE0-$FFFF), $89C9 sets bits in (H = $FF, L = the object's +$11); on the tape the ROM's 'R'-'U'
